info.name: Pivot API - Organization Authentication
info.description:
Separate authentication for the Mobile App and the Organization Dashboard.

Select the Pivot Local or Pivot Staging environment, then set the email and password variables. The login requests save their tokens automatically.

A mobile token works only on Mobile App APIs, and a dashboard token works only on Organization Dashboard APIs. Each returns 401 on the other's APIs.

Full guide: Docs/Postman_Organization_API_Documentation_Guide.md

item.name: 1. Mobile App
item.description: Existing Mobile App authentication. Unchanged. Tokens from here do not work on dashboard APIs.

request.description: Uses the mobile password. Saves the token as mobileToken.
Mobile App profile. Accepts only a mobile token.

item.name: 2. Organization Dashboard Authentication
item.description: Uses dashboard credentials, which are separate from the mobile password.

request.description:
Allowed for ORG_OWNER, ORG_ADMIN, ORG_ANALYST, PIVOT_SUPER_ADMIN and PIVOT_SUPPORT. Saves the token as dashboardToken.

Rate limit: 5 attempts per minute per email and IP, and 20 per minute per IP.

request.description:
Emails a link: a first-time setup link if no password is set yet, otherwise a reset link. Returns the same response whether or not the email exists.

Rate limit: 5 per hour per email and IP, and 20 per hour per IP.

response.name: 200 Always the same

request.description:
Used for both first-time setup and reset. Copy token from the emailed link into the passwordToken variable. On success, signs out every dashboard session. Mobile sessions and the mobile password are not affected.

Password rules: at least 12 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol.

Rate limit: 10 per minute per IP.

response.name: 200 Success
422 Invalid or expired link
422 Password rules

request.description: Revokes only the token used for this request. Other dashboard sessions and all mobile sessions stay signed in.

response.name: 401 Missing, invalid, expired or mobile token
403 No dashboard access
